cohort: 100 patients with ASA physical scores of I-II who underwent caesarean section under the Pfannenstiel incision method under subarachnoid anaesthesia with 0.5% heavy bupivacaine.
finding: Patients who received ultrasound-guided TAP block with dexmedetomidine required significantly less on-demand tramadol and had significantly lower VAS scores at 3, 6, and 12 hours postoperatively compared to those who received dexamethasone.
